column1: # OCTOPATH TRAVELER II: Square Enix / Acquire, Unreal Engine 4.27, SDK 12.3.2, NVN.
# Experimental Android profile for update 1.1.1 (v131072); no Android build or device run yet.
# Version, memory and shader metadata reference: seedds/nxnative commit
# 16f4889192dd9bc6363a77b5d8b9654fe65441a2. See README.md for provenance and validation gaps.
# subsdk0 supplies NintendoSDK_movie; preserve Horizon's module order.
# Keep the original upstream layout, which uses the existing build-keyed allocator gate
# (patches.py + ue_malloc.tsv) and SDK node-area cuts, rather than newer upstream engine-wide rules.
# Unreal reserves 62 GB by default. Cap it to 2 GB; the alias region also allows the
# 62 MB SDK node area and up to 1 GB alignment. 256 MB stacks and 384 MB heap remain.
# The upstream survey reports an 80 MB NPDM system resource.
# Weapon selection needs the D-pad. L / R cycle through travelers on the selection screen.
# Preserve the game's 30 fps limit until Android validation. The build-keyed fps_locks.tsv
# also supports an explicit DM_FPS_TARGET=60; this is a requested cap, not a measured rate.
# The v11 pak holds LZ4 shaders inline in cooked packages and the global shader cache;
# it has no .ushaderbytecode archive. These tables are upstream reference metadata,
# not a shader split measured with nx2android. Validate them against the real dump before promotion.
